Q5738.reason: The UCC applies to a mixed goods-and-services contract only if goods are the predominant purpose, a positive requirement rather than a default that applies unless services predominate.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires felonious intent at the moment of entry, and he entered only to enjoy the party, deciding to take the ball only after he was already inside.

Q8324.reason: Chronic dopamine flooding leads the postsynaptic neuron to downregulate dopamine receptors, so ordinary dopamine no longer registers and the person is driven to seek more drug.
